```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, error = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

## dataset

```{r}
drinks = tibble(
  Row = 1:4,
  Drink = c("Milk Tea", "Espresso", "Latte", "Espresso"),
  Cafe = c("Happy Tea", "Daily Grind", "Daily Grind", "Bev's Beverages"),
  Price = c(4, 2, 3, 2)
)

drinks
```

```{r}
discounts = tibble(
  Row = 1:3,
  Coupon = c("25%", "50%", "5%"),
  Cafe = c("Happy Tea", "Daily Grind", "The Roast")
)

discounts
```

## Mutating joins

```{r}
left_join(drinks, discounts, by = "Cafe")
```

```{r}
right_join(drinks, discounts, by = "Cafe")

right_join(discounts, drinks, by = "Cafe")
```


```{r}
full_join(drinks, discounts, by = "Cafe")
```
```{r}
inner_join(drinks, discounts, by = "Cafe")
```

```{r}
left_join(drinks, discounts, by  = "Cafe")
```
```{r}
left_join(drinks, discounts)
```

```{r}
discounts1 <- discounts %>% rename(Locations = Cafe) %>% select(-Row)

discounts1 %>% left_join(drinks, by = join_by(Locations == Cafe))
```

## filtering joins

```{r}
semi_join(drinks, discounts, by = "Cafe")
semi_join(discounts, drinks, by = "Cafe")
```

```{r}
inner_join(drinks, discounts, by = "Cafe")
```

```{r}
anti_join(drinks, discounts, by = "Cafe")
anti_join(discounts, drinks, by = "Cafe")
```
